# Issue

**Title:** MRG: use auto-generated database list

## Description

This PR integrates the database pages built by https://github.com/sourmash-bio/2025-sourmash-databases-doc-template/ into the sourmash docs.

The revised databases page is [here](https://sourmash--3754.org.readthedocs.build/en/3754/databases.html).

The revised legacy databases page is [here](https://sourmash--3754.org.readthedocs.build/en/3754/legacy-databases.html).

In summary, this PR:
* moves most current databases (pre-2025) into the legacy database list;
* mentions zip and RocksDB and provides sourmash version info;
* provides top-level links to GTDB RS220 and RS226, NCBI euks, and NCBI viruses, which are all auto-generated by the templating engine;
